load_bearing_quotes.verbatim: The formal results establish a deepest-root property for path-convex regions, exact conditional exchange identities, and component-count arithmetic. The correspondence between these objects and graph-theoretic agreement forests remains open. A compiled conditional identity does not establish its graph hypotheses.
load_bearing_quotes.type: retrieved candidate scope; no universal graph proof attributed

load_bearing_quotes.verbatim: | G1 | The unsuppressed minimal embedding of a nonempty label subset is a `RootedRegion` under a label-preserving binary-address representation. | `deepest_root_in_neighbor` |
load_bearing_quotes.type: retrieved candidate scope; no universal graph proof attributed

load_bearing_quotes.verbatim: | G2 | If two disjoint-label embeddings overlap only at vertices of degree two in each, every block meeting their overlap uses its whole path. Avoiding one overlap vertex therefore avoids the other complete embedding. | `freeLeft`, `freeRight` |
load_bearing_quotes.type: retrieved candidate scope; no universal graph proof attributed

load_bearing_quotes.verbatim: | G3 | If a valid agreement piece uses a degree-two vertex of its component embedding, the labels on the two sides form a nonempty two-piece agreement refinement. The refinement avoids that vertex and preserves every prior mark and every other disjoint piece. | Local one-cut bound and `clearRest` |
load_bearing_quotes.type: retrieved candidate scope; no universal graph proof attributed

load_bearing_quotes.verbatim: | G4 | In a global forest, at most one piece uses a fixed vertex; applying G3 to that piece preserves global feasibility. | `clearRest` for the entire remainder |
load_bearing_quotes.type: retrieved candidate scope; no universal graph proof attributed

load_bearing_quotes.verbatim: | G5 | Deleting marked vertices and discarding leafless regions gives precisely the common refinements of the source tree and the forest of target restrictions to the nonempty regions, including embedding-disjointness under suppression. | Common partition family in `role_swap_minimum` |
load_bearing_quotes.type: retrieved candidate scope; no universal graph proof attributed

load_bearing_quotes.verbatim: | G6 | The region leaf partition can be represented by `r−1` target-edge cuts even when deleted vertices leave leafless intermediate regions. Refining an ordinary `d`-cut forest by those cuts adds at most `r−1` pieces. | Hypothesis `h≤d+r−1` |
load_bearing_quotes.type: retrieved candidate scope; no universal graph proof attributed

load_bearing_quotes.verbatim: | G7 | The implementation supplies attained exact marked minima and implements each elimination invariant, including compatibility with previously fixed witnesses. | Recursive algorithm correctness |
load_bearing_quotes.type: retrieved candidate scope; no universal graph proof attributed

inferences: GraphRegion theorem supplies graph-connected-support realization; executable extraction remains unproved.
